api_rate_limited: Too many attempts, try again in a minute.
emails_intro: Every verified address of yours can log you in. The primary one is the official address of the account: it is the one shown in the header. A new address stays unusable until its verification link has been followed.
household_alone: You are the only member: this household is deleted, not left.
household_intro: Renaming it and deleting it belong to its owners. Leaving it leaves behind the person you were here, without their account.
household_last_owner: You are the last owner: appoint someone else before leaving.
household_new_intro: A household gathers the people you pack for.
household_personal_intro: Your own space: what you prepare without sharing it.
household_shared_intro: A household shared with its members.
invitation_account_after: . The link does not check which address it was sent to: this is the account that will become a member.
invitation_account_before: You are about to join this household with the account
invitation_anonymous: Joining a household takes an account. Log in if you already have one, otherwise create it: once your address is confirmed, come back to this link — the one in the invitation email — to accept.
invitation_dead: This invitation is unknown, expired, or has already been accepted — the API does not say which of the three. A link is worth a week and works once. Ask an owner of the household to send you a new one.
invitation_intro: You keep your personal household: this one joins the switcher, it replaces nothing.
invitation_sent: If this address can be invited, it will receive a link. The household does not say who already has an account: the invitation appears below if it was created.
invitations_intro: A link worth a week, sent to an address. Whoever accepts it then picks the person they already are here, or creates one.
login_intro: Log in with your email address.
me_name_intro: The name other members see is the one of the person who represents you in each household, not a field of the account: it is changed
password_intro: The current password is asked for: a stolen session must not be enough to change it.
people_intro: Everything the application prepares is for someone. A child is a person without an account, a partner a person whose account has joined the household.
person_claim_prompt: You are a member of this household without being anyone in it yet. Pick the person you are to be able to change anything.
reset_intro: We send you a link to choose a new one.
reset_key_dead: This link has expired or has already been used.
reset_sent: If an account uses this address, a link has just been sent to it.
signup_intro: An email address and a password are enough.
signup_pending: Account created. A verification email has just gone out: follow its link to activate your account.
strangers_heading: Members who are nobody in this household yet:
verify_confirm: Confirm that {email} is indeed your address.
verify_dead_after: if your account is already active.
verify_dead_before: This link has expired or has already been used. Start a new
verify_done_signed_in: Address confirmed, you are now logged in.
